tutorialModal.title: Public Inventory & Seller Activation Guide
tutorialModal.description: To index and price your skins, receive instant trade offers, and cash out funds without delay, your Steam inventory access must be set to Public.
tutorialModal.step1Desc: In the Steam client or Steam Community web page, click your username and select 'View my profile'.
tutorialModal.step2Desc: Click 'Edit Profile' and navigate to 'Privacy Settings' from the side menu to adjust visibility controls.
tutorialModal.step3Desc: Under 'My Profile', locate 'Inventory' and set it to 'Public' so CS2 & Dota 2 items can be appraised.
tutorialModal.step4Desc: Go to Trade Offers › 'Who can send me Trade Offers', copy your access URL, and save it in Relicto settings.
tutorialModal.finalStepDesc: Verify seller identity for instant settlements, higher volume limits, and the Verified Trader badge.
